carries no embedded licence text.

Licence evidence (checked 2026-09-29)
  Poly Pizza page states: "Public Domain (CC0)" and links
    https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
  The 2021 pack page on quaternius.com states: "License CC0".
  Quaternius's licence page (https://quaternius.com/license.html) now shows the
  "Quaternius Asset License (QAL) v1.0", last updated 8/28/2026. It forbids redistributing
  "the Assets themselves ... as a standalone asset" and says "the version in effect at the
  time you obtained the Assets governs your use of them". This model was obtained as CC0
  (Poly Pizza page and the 2021 pack page above), so it is recorded here as CC0-1.0. It is
  used inside a game and is not redistributed as a standalone asset.

Licence re-check (2026-10-01)
  The 2021 pack page https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html still
  states "License: CC0" and links https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
  The Poly Pizza page https://poly.pizza/m/qvTrSG9pZF still states "Public Domain (CC0)".
  The QAL v1.0 page (last updated 8/28/2026) says nothing about assets earlier released
  under CC0, and the CC0 1.0 waiver is irrevocable.

Decision (2026-10-01)
  The owner keeps this model. It stays recorded as CC0-1.0 in assets/attribution.json
  and ASSETS.md.
